notes: PIA = 90% of AIME up to the first bend point + 32% up to the second + 15% above; bend points for the year you turn 62.
AIME = highest 35 years of earnings (each capped at that year's taxable maximum), wage-indexed to the year you turn 60, / 420, rounded down.
Covered earnings counted: military basic pay (FICA wages) and civilian salary. Grad-school stipends/fellowships aren't Social Security wages; pensions and VA aren't earnings.
